causal_join_rule: A family may become exposure-certified only when read-only evidence shows the existing authority/productive path actually participated in the observed outcome; metadata presence alone is insufficient.
failure_rule: Missing, ambiguous, unjoined or degraded evidence fails closed as NOT_VALIDLY_MEASURABLE_UNDER_HCPDQ_V2, never CAPABILITY_ABSENT.

abstention requires WITHHELD confidence and unavailable verification
